evals.prompt: Watch me do this once, then do it yourself next time: I will rename the exported file in the browser box's workspace.
evals.expected_output: Loads boxes from SKILL.md. Resolves BOXES_ROOT from the skill tool's base directory and invokes its absolute box path from any working directory.
